items.title: Reducing Memory Overhead in Valkey 9.1
items.summary: The Valkey project says Valkey 9.1 reduces per-key memory overhead, and that a dedicated cache near full capacity with an eviction policy may see a higher hit rate.
evidence: Valkey 9.1 introduces three optimizations that reduce the per-key memory overhead
dedicated cache running near full capacity with an eviction policy such as allkeys-lru
your cache may achieve a higher hit rate without requiring any changes

items.title: Manage caches with precision using Amazon CloudFront Invalidation by Cache Tag
items.summary: Amazon Web Services describes purging CloudFront objects by cache tag in one request, and says invalidations take effect in under 5 seconds and complete in under 25, both at P95.
evidence: reporting the invalidation status back, is under 25 seconds at P95
you can invalidate groups of related cached objects using a single invalidation request
invalidations take effect in under 5 seconds at P95
